milestones.title: Application Reviewed at City Planning Commission Review Session
milestones.description: A "Review Session" milestone signifies that the application has been sent to the City Planning Commission (CPC) and is ready for review. The "Review" milestone represents the period of time (up to 60 days) that the CPC reviews the application before their vote.

milestones.title: Community Board Review
milestones.description: The Community Board has 60 days from the time of referral (nine days after certification) to hold a hearing and issue a recommendation.

milestones.title: Borough President Review

milestones.title: City Council Review
